title: Asparagus and butter bean pot with feta

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is plain food a grandparent would keep, with tinned butter beans, stock, feta and bread all explicitly allowed.

supermarket.reason: All the items are everyday supermarket lines, and broad beans in pods are on the fresh list for May.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs one wide lidded pan and simple softening and simmering, well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Two tins of beans, 300ml stock, broad beans, asparagus and 200g feta with bread make a sensible brothy lunch for four, and the timings will leave the green vegetables just tender.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers podding the broad beans, slicing the spring onions, garlic and asparagus and zesting the lemon, and the 12 minutes cooking matches the 3 + 5 + 4 in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon and mint, appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Asparagus leads a light, warm spring bean pot that suits mid-May, though the 250g is shared with two tins of beans.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Beans, green vegetables, feta and bread make a filling, balanced lunch a family would happily eat again.
